reviews.text: It’s helps me keep track of my day and habits and moods I just love it.

reviews.title: Copycat?
reviews.text: This looks like a total copy of the DearMe app. Same screenshots and everything

reviews.title: Too many issues
reviews.text: Was very hopeful about this app. Even paid the subscription. But it is constantly an issue to use. It won’t check things off my to do list. When it does, it’s marked under the next day. My routines always have trouble loading and are constantly getting erased. Very disappointing and frustrating. Wish I could go back and save my money by never downloading this app. 10/10 WOULD NOT RECOMMEND

reviews.title: Just asks questions and asks for money
reviews.text: I downloaded the app, it asked 50 questions, only to be taken to a payment screen. When I tried to click X to just see what the app was like as a free feature, I got pop ups advertising discounts. I still don’t know how the app works because I gave up and deleted. Thats 15 minutes Ill never get back. Don’t waste your time. Don’t bother downloading.

reviews.title: Paid subscription required
reviews.text: App should advertise that there is a required subscription to use it. Would not have downloaded had I known there wasn’t even a sample to try.

reviews.title: Not working right
reviews.text: It Won’t let me take any quizzes .

reviews.title: Needs more
reviews.text: I like this app as someone who has severe ADHD. But because of my ADHD, I really need an app like this to have the ability to send notifications to my Apple Watch and sync with Alexa. Even better would be the ability to connect and share with someone (like a spouse, babysitter, etc). I think it has potential, but just isn’t worth the money for me as a glorified list. If there were more features, I would be willing to pay for it.
